title: Seafood Capital & Diwal Sanctuary
description: Roxas City's vast coastal estuaries, clean Sibuyan marine waters, and rich mangrove ecosystems sustain the Philippines' highest concentration of premium seafood. The resurgence of the rare Diwal (angel wing clam) stands as a national triumph of community-led marine conservation.

title: Cradle of the First Republic President
description: The ancestral legacy of President Manuel A. Roxas defines the city's civic ethos. His preserved birthplace along Rizal Street stands as a timeless monument to Filipino statesmanship, constitutional leadership, and post-war nation building.

title: Panay River & Mangrove Lifeline
description: Meandering through the heart of the city, the Panay River is both an ecological artery and a cultural highway. Community river tours at Palina and Cadimahan demonstrate how local fisherfolk lead sustainable ecotourism and mangrove preservation.

title: Capiz Shell Artistry & Cultural Soul
description: From radiant Placuna placenta shellcraft to the spirited Sinadya sa Halaran festival, Roxas City harmonizes time-honored Hiligaynon traditions with modern civic energy and genuine Visayan hospitality.
